description_en: Queries an agent visible to the current identity by name
description_zh: 按名称查询当前身份可见的 Agent
name: GetAgent

CanDelete.description_en: Indicates whether the current identity can delete the agent
CanDelete.description_zh: 当前身份是否可以删除该 Agent

CanModify.description_en: Indicates whether the current identity can modify the agent
CanModify.description_zh: 当前身份是否可以修改该 Agent

CreatedAt.description_en: The creation time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreatedAt.description_zh: 创建时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

Description.description_en: The description of the agent. This field may not be returned if it is not configured
Description.description_zh: Agent 描述，未配置时可能不返回
Description.example: 分析代码变更并生成 CR 评审意见

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the agent. This field may not be returned if it is not configured
DisplayName.description_zh: Agent 展示名称，未配置时可能不返回

KnowledgeBases.description_en: The list of knowledge base references. The list contains at most one element
KnowledgeBases.description_zh: 知识库引用列表，最多包含一个元素

Metadata.description_en: The display metadata of the agent. For specific fields, see "Supplementary description of response elements"
Metadata.description_zh: Agent 展示元数据，具体字段参见“返回参数补充说明”

Model.description_en: The saved model configuration. This field is returned only for official agents. The value supports an object array and is compatible with legacy single objects and strings. An empty array returns [ ]. Object arrays preserve the original order, duplicate names, and object fields
Model.description_zh: 已保存的模型配置，仅官方 Agent 返回此信息。支持对象数组，并兼容历史单对象和字符串。空数组返回 [ ]。对象数组保持原顺序、重复名称和对象字段

Official.description_en: Indicates whether the agent is an official agent provided by the platform
Official.description_zh: 是否为平台提供的官方 Agent

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used for Tracing Analysis and troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于链路追踪和问题排查

Skills.description_en: The list of skill references. For specific fields, see "Supplementary description of response elements"
Skills.description_zh: Skill 引用列表，具体字段参见“返回参数补充说明”

Status.description_en: The status of the agent. The default status of a newly created agent is `draft`
Status.description_zh: Agent 状态。新建 Agent 的默认状态为 `draft`

SystemPrompt.description_en: The system prompt. This field may not be returned if it is not configured
SystemPrompt.description_zh: 系统提示词，未配置时可能不返回
SystemPrompt.example: 请检查 CR 中代码变更的正确性、安全性和可维护性，并按严重程度给出评审意见。

Tools.description_en: The list of MCP Server and Connector name references. For element fields, see the following section
Tools.description_zh: MCP Server 与 Connector 名称引用列表，元素字段参见下文

UpdatedAt.description_en: The most recent update time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
UpdatedAt.description_zh: 最近更新时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

Visibility.description_en: The visibility scope of the agent. Valid values: `user` and `tenant`
Visibility.description_zh: Agent 可见范围。可选值为 `user` 和 `tenant`
